services.description: List of service instances to configure for dbf2mysql(1). Each defines a full invocation with its options and input file. At least one required to produce valid output. Items must be flat objects with keys per documented option, using only documented option names mapped to their correct argument types/semantics (see individual fields below).

services[].add_rec_timestamp.description: Add _rec and _timestamp fields to table. Corresponds to -x.

services[].allow_null.description: Allow NULL fields: omit NOT NULL in table creation. Corresponds to -n.

services[].charset.description: Character set to use in table. Corresponds to -C.

services[].conversion_file.description: Path to CHAR conversion file. Corresponds to -e.

services[].create_mode.description: Table creation mode: 'drop_create' (-c), 'create_only' (-cc), or '' (insert into existing only).

services[].database.description: Target MySQL database. Default is 'test'. Corresponds to -d.

services[].description.description: Optional description of what this service does (comment only).

services[].fixed_length.description: Treat CHAR fields as fixed-length (not VARCHAR). Corresponds to -F.

services[].host.description: MySQL host. Untested per man page. Corresponds to -h.

services[].include_fields.description: List of xBase field names to include (processed before renaming/skipping). Corresponds to -o.

services[].index_fields.description: List of MySQL field names to be indexed. Corresponds to -i.

services[].input_file.description: Path to the input .dbf file. Required per invocation.

services[].local_infile.description: Use LOCAL INFILE for loading data. Corresponds to -L.

services[].lowercase_fields.description: Translate all field names in the xBase file to lowercase. Corresponds to -f.

services[].name.description: Logical name for the service instance (used only in comment).

services[].password.description: MySQL password. Corresponds to -P. Suggested to leave blank or use credentials file in production.

services[].primary_key.description: MySQL field name to use as primary key. Corresponds to -p.

services[].quick_mode.description: Enable 'quick' mode (LOAD DATA INFILE). Corresponds to -q.

services[].rename_fields.description: List of [old-name, new-name] pairs for field renaming, e.g., ['ORDER', 'HORDER']. Corresponds to -s with non-empty new-name.

services[].skip_fields.description: List of [old-name, new-name] pairs where new-name is empty to skip fields (e.g., ['REMARKS', '']). Corresponds to -s with empty new-name.

services[].table.description: Target MySQL table. Default is 'test'. Corresponds to -t.

services[].trim_chars.description: Trim leading/trailing whitespace from CHAR fields. Corresponds to -r.

services[].uppercase_text.description: Translate text case: 'u' (uppercase), 'l' (lowercase), 'L' (LOCAL INFILE — note: documented as -L but this is a separate flag), or '' (none).
